risk_summary: The excerpt provides meaningful quantitative disclosure on financing, sales mix, operating improvements, costs, and industry conditions, but relies substantially on broad risk factors and forward-looking expectations. Key risks include high-cost secured debt, fertilizer oversupply and price volatility, coal-market contraction, and dependence on natural gas and agricultural economics. Operational performance improved in 2018, although reported gross profit benefited from nonrecurring recoveries and SG&A increased due to severance and legal expenses.
